title: Convert a title to title case with lowercase small words
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: It is a JavaScript function named titleCase, so there is no Python title_case function as the brief requires.
It lowercases small words only strictly between the first and last word and capitalises every other word, with single spaces and TypeError for non-strings.
It never capitalises a small last word, so title_case("something to believe in") returns "Something to Believe in" instead of "Something to Believe In".
It drops empty pieces between spaces, keeps small words lowercase except at index 0 and the last index, and capitalises everything else as the brief requires.
